tellings.difference: Told firsthand, and links the egg-taking to the reported cloning of baby Eve in December 2002, after she was taken there in September.
tellings.link_reason: Juliet Byron tells firsthand the same belief that her eggs were taken at Zorro Ranch in 2002, which telling 7 relayed.

as_told.title: Eggs taken and the 2002 cloned baby Eve

related.note: Both are about what was done to women taken to Zorro Ranch. The existing story claims they were to be inseminated in a breeding program; this telling claims their eggs were harvested.

plain: On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, about the late financier Jeffrey Epstein, a guest named Jay Anderson passes on what a woman named Juliet Byron told him: that she and some other women believe their eggs were taken from them at a ranch in New Mexico called Zorro Ranch. Byron, speaking for herself, says she was taken there in September 2002, and links it to reports that the first cloned baby, called Eve, was born that December, after which, she says, nobody heard anything more. If true, it would mean women were secretly used for a human cloning effort.
